patch_description: Replace the generic point construction with a deterministic, hard-coded 13-point configuration exhibiting 3-fold rotational symmetry (3 outer hull vertices, 6 mid-ring points, 3 inner-ring points, 1 center). The configuration is then normalized so the convex hull has exactly unit area. This is fully deterministic, avoids stochastic search entirely, executes in microseconds, and reliably improves the minimum normalized triangle area compared to a random baseline by exploiting the empirically strong 3-fold symmetry structure of good Heilbronn configurations.
